race.comment: Tough one - there's been little between most of these when they've raced. MAKDANE (2) was game here last start over 1700m when just run down by First Chorus, sitting on a solid tempo there when beaten a head. On paper his 2000m doesn't look flash but he's run well in some stronger races at the trip and will be very hard to run down. AMLETO (11) is racing very well. He was heavily backed here last time when run down by PRINCE ERIC (3) who had the right run protected from the wind. PRINCE ERIC had been given no hope when finishing behind AMLETO and BELLE SAVOIR (12) the start prior. BELLE SAVOIR was just fair last time - fancy her win two back was an anomaly. STOP THE ROCK (6) got home well behind PRINCE ERIC last time and is another in the mix.
